composite_multiaxial_rule: Do not force one mutually exclusive final category when evidence supports orthogonal axes.
target_family_holdout_rule: When target is close to historical comparators, repeat sensitivity without same-family historical cases.
amendment_rule: Disease-specific module cannot edit frozen framework.
holdout_method: Psychiatric/developmental historical cases removed; each promoted criterion revalidated for at least one explicit nonpsychiatric supporting comparator in the v0.2 historical evidence map. Criteria lacking nonpsychiatric support would be disabled; none of U01-U09/D01/E01/Q01/Q02/S01/R01/R02 failed this check.
